rule.main: among the eligible candidates that clear the bar and are better than ref: the cheapest; a costlier one replaces it when it is better than it (the cheapest such, repeated until none is)
rule.fast: the same among the eligible candidates at est. <= fast_ms_max_333_960 (tier 1); when none of them is better than ref, the same with fast_ref as the comparator (tier 2, labelled so); else no fast pick

rule.candidates: the median-seed candidates of every textspot2 arm except r0 (controls) and the teacher ceiling (report only)

ignore areas: meiki boxes of score 0.2-0.5; the textspot winner's boxes (det decode, C runtime) that no meiki box >= 0.2 and no positive covers (>= 50% of the box); the canvas's existing ignore areas except one that a new positive's raw meiki box overlaps at IoU >= 0.5
weights: 1 for existing positives and for a meiki positive with >= 50% of its box inside a winner box; else 0.5 + 0.5 min(1, (score - 0.5) / 0.3)
a positive's weight multiplies the K BCE, O and A losses of its kernel cells; every other valid cell weighs 1; dice and the normalisations are #97's

lab.what: r0 with the real half's labels replaced by labels_b (the same canvases)

ema.what: data + an exponential moving average of the weights: decay 0.999 from step 1,000; at the QAT start the averaged weights replace the live ones and BatchNorm statistics are re-estimated on 32 batches; during QAT an average (0.999) of the QAT weights, which is the run's model

cls.what: data + class weights: 2 on the lines of class dialogue, name and choice (synthetic frames; the real half has no classes), 1 otherwise (multiplied with labels_b's weights)

long.what: data + ema + 60,000 steps, peak LR 2e-3 (1,000 warm-up steps, cosine to 1e-4), QAT from step 48,000

kd.what: data + the kept extras + distillation from the teacher spotter: loss = the label loss + BCE(K, sigmoid(K_t)) over valid cells + 0.5 BCE(O, sigmoid(O_t)) + smooth L1((A1 - A1_t) / 8) + smooth L1((A2 - A2_t) / 8) on cells where sigmoid(K_t) > 0.5; the teacher's maps on the same window at the same scale

recipes.common: textspot's recipe otherwise: 16 windows of 256 x 512 at the network's scale, h2 (half_above 600), AdamW 4e-3 (except long), 500 warm-up steps, cosine to 1e-4, QAT from 80% of the steps, 30,000 steps (except long), the last step is the run's model; trainer train/textspot2_train.py (textspot's trainer imported; its pinned files unchanged)

shapes.grammar: train/textdet_model.layers: stem 3x3 stride 2 (1 -> c0), down (sep: dw 3x3 stride 2 + 1x1; plain: 3x3 stride 2) to c1, for stride 8 down8 to c2, the blocks (sep: dw 3x3 dilation d + 1x1; plain: 3x3 dilation d), head 1x1 -> 4 maps (kroa) or 16 (kroa_x2: 4 maps for each of a cell's 2 x 2 sub-cells)

d2s.what: a 2 x 2 sub-pixel head: the head's 16 channels are K, O, A1, A2 for each of a cell's four sub-cells (dy, dx); the decode reads them as a map at half the network's stride (cell (2i + dy, 2j + dx)), cropped to ceil(H / (s / 2)) x ceil(W / (s / 2)), and is otherwise the textspot decode
d2s.format: a VTSP version 2 that says so; a version-1 blob runs bit for bit as before in the twin and the runtime, and a runtime without the extension refuses version 2
d2s.condition: the d2s arms run only if the extension (twin, runtime, export, trainer), its parity tests and its A9 rows are committed on feat/textspot2 before stage 2 starts; else they are reported as not run. The runtime change is merged only if a selected model needs it

what: Coverage. Wherever the labels (b) say a box is covered (>= 50%), at least 50% of its area lies inside the UNION of the named boxes (existing positives; meiki boxes of score >= 0.2, raw; the textspot winner's boxes), so a line split into two boxes still counts as covered.

Furigana. A meiki box is an ignore area, never a positive, when the source record's furigana boxes ('furi' of its lines, teacher/geometry.attach_furigana) cover >= 50% of it, or when it is furigana of a bigger meiki box or positive by teacher/geometry.is_furigana's geometry without its kana test (its height at most 0.65 x the host's, inside the host's horizontal extent +- 4 px, its centre above the host's top third, its bottom at most half the host's height above the host's top): meiki's detector reads no text, and the development and test labels make furigana an ignore area.

Refinement. teacher/geometry.refine is horizontal: a vertical box (refined height >= 1.5 x width, else its raw box's) is refined on the transposed crop; a box refine returns unchanged keeps its raw extent; the size gates (6-96 px across) read the refined box at the canvas's scale.

what: Winner-only boxes. A textspot winner box that no positive and no meiki box > 0.2 covers (>= 50%, union) becomes an ignore area only when the winner's confidence (the box's mean K code, 1..127) is >= 40; below 40 it is left as textspot's labels leave it (background, a negative). Evidence, training canvases only: the helper's pre-build QA sheet of 40 random winner-only boxes ($HERD/shared/private/textspot2/labels/qa/qa_a_winner_only.png, seed 20261020, viewed once by the helper and once by the conductor): the conductor counted 21 text (UI buttons, name plates, choices, a date, a map label) and 19 not text (icons, ornaments, patterns, a gap); 19 of the 21 text boxes have confidence >= 40 and 15 of the 19 others below 40. Making every winner-only box an ignore area would have removed the hard negatives of the winner's own false positives (about half the boxes).

Low-score boxes. A meiki box of score in (0.2, 0.5) that the existing positives cover (>= 50%, union) is dropped (neither positive nor ignore), so the negatives between labelled lines stay; an uncovered one is an ignore area as registered (the QA sheet of 40 uncovered low-score boxes: 19 text, 17 not, 4 unsure by the helper; meiki's score does not separate them in the conductor's look, so no threshold is added).

The labels helper's readings, binding as written in $HERD/shared/artifacts/textspot2/labels/questions_20261020T0920.md: (1) refine as geometry.refine does, vertical iff that box (the raw box when refine returned it unchanged) is >= 1.5x as tall as wide, then a vertical box is re-refined on the transposed crop; (2) 'no existing positive covers it' is tested on the meiki box's refined box; (4) the ignore area of a low-score, furigana or size-gated meiki box is its refined box (raw boxes only where amendment 1 says raw); (5) furigana candidates are horizontal; hosts are every other horizontal meiki box (refined, score > 0.2) and every horizontal existing positive; (6) 'score >= 0.2' is meiki's score > 0.2, candidates [0.5, 1]; (7) arm c's caps count screenshots per VN, existing lab screenshots included: pc (realplus and the teacher's PC shots) 8, native (the teacher's Vita / PSP and devnative) 12, owner 200; a shot in two sources' records joins the first of realplus, teacher, devnative, owner; (8) arm c also leaves out realplus(-v3)'s thumbnail-leak shots and any row whose sha256 is not its file's; hygiene as #97 ran it (eval/tools/reserve_check.py --require-hashes --pixels and eval/tools/leakcheck.py); (9) lab keeps #97's owner canvases of the three owner -TEST folders that reserved.json does not reserve (v10, v17863, v18334: textspot's real half); arm c leaves every -TEST folder out; (10) the manifest's skip block copies textspot's two lists with their list sha256, its counts are what textspot2's shards still hold (0) and textspot's counts are kept beside them.
